frozen_information: Only prior study reports, the official accession-name inventory, physical units, clocks, a source-only schema check and the prior acquisition split informed this protocol. No movement values or results for this forecasting question were inspected. Groups are acquisition codes, not verified individuals. These recordings were previously available to hand-caption model development.
source: All and only the 29 former train sessions, 17 groups. Source owner admission, deduplication, confidence and text filtering apply. Include eligible unrated and explicitly high instructor instructions, report confidence and strict-high coverage. No reserve, earlier assessment or official evaluation recording.
split_basis: Fixed on names alone for coverage of all six tasks in both roles; all other cohort groups train. Multiple recordings from each R-code stay together.
cutoff: The first released RGB clock row on or after the annotated complete instructor utterance end +0.250 s. No words from later utterances. No chronological filtering based on future conversation, actions, recording duration, tracking or target values.
history: Right wrist joint 1; active, valid, tracked, all finite. At cutoff and at offsets -0.25, -0.5, -1 seconds take most recent observed synchronized row at/before requested time (at most 0.100 s stale). Require four strictly distinct, increasing native ticks, strictly increasing grid times and positive actual intervals. Determination of input eligibility uses only currently/past available rows. No interpolation or future fill.
target: At cutoff+1.0 s take most recent observed row at/before that time within 0.100 s of the requested endpoint; must be strictly future on grid and sensor tick. Scalar Euclidean displacement from the latest available cutoff wrist to this endpoint, reported in cm. Right-censoring and missing tracking/excluded endpoint counts reported; accuracy applies only to scorable cases. Report actual end-to-cutoff, cutoff-to-future and past-to-future grid leads and native elapsed. No exact UTC alignment with audio is claimed.
features: Past motion: three interval velocities, each xyz and norm, in cm/s using grid sampling times, plus norm of full one-second net displacement and four stalenesses. No absolute session position. Known controls: one-hot task, log1p elapsed recording seconds at cutoff, log1p completed utterance duration, count of distinct allowlisted words and unrated bit. No future-derived time, normalized recording progress, future actions or recording length.
controls: Persistence (0 cm) and last-segment constant-velocity speed times the known time from observed wrist to requested horizon (ignores actual future endpoint); prior one-second net displacement; past-motion ridge; motion + task/timing/known nonlexical summary ridge (primary comparator); full ridge with actual binary word membership; same fitted full model with words removed or substituted from same-task TRAIN-only utterance in a different R-group. Choose donor by minimum sum of absolute differences in log1p(duration) and log1p(elapsed cutoff), then stable recording, event ID. Also require a different token bag; count eligible matches, flag failures, compare only on identical matched rows. Never exchange recipient task/timing/motion fields.
learner: Train models once on identical scorable training rows, minimum 40 rows, 4 train groups. Vocabulary fixed to source allowlist words observed in >=3 eligible training rows; binary, unscaled word inputs. Standardize numerical controls on training rows; categorical task one-hot unscaled. Ridge with intercept, normalized training weights equal across R groups, then within group recordings, then utterances; objective weighted mean squared cm loss +0.025 * squared slope norm. All predictions clipped at zero, no upper cap. No validation tuning or refit after assessing.
attention: Only if >=160 training examples, >=8 training groups and >=20 retained word types: exploratory same-row conditioning, d=8 single-head query from standardized nonlexical and motion features, keys/values learned for unordered retained distinct words plus always-on null word. Linear context residual over frozen no-word ridge. CPU float32 full batch, 80 epochs AdamW lr=.01 decay=.01, seed 17, normalized group weights, training target-SD units; compare correct, removed and same frozen donors. No selection over models or epochs.
assessment: Freeze implementation before reading assessment outcomes. Training data count gates precede learned assessment. If <4 scorable assessment groups or <20 examples, descriptive feasibility only. Report MAE in cm for each model; average events then recordings then groups. Paired differences and 95% percentile cluster bootstrap, 2000 draws seed 917 on per-group differences, exploratory at <=6 groups. Positive language evidence requires primary full ridge lower error than all physical/learned baselines and both word controls on matched rows, and lower endpoint of paired bootstrap gain over primary ridge and both word controls >0. No positive claims otherwise. Emphasize dependence, group counts, selection and missingness. Control fallback unavailable if no training same-task distinct donor.
privacy: No verbatim utterance, raw conversation, participant-specific traces or row predictions in public outputs; train-only safe vocabulary/model coefficients, aggregate numbers, code and weights only. No intervention, physiological or causal claims.
